name: Pre-Orders, Product Badges, Buy Now, Quick View, Advanced Cart and More for WooCommerce – ManageX
author: SoftTent

sections.description:
ManageX is a powerful all-in-one WooCommerce solution that enhances your store with 18+ essential extensions. Boost conversions, improve user experience, and streamline your store management with comprehensive features.

Key Features:

🛒 Cart & Checkout Extensions

Buy Now – Direct Checkout
Send customers straight to checkout, skipping the cart page. Reduce friction and abandoned carts with one-click purchase.

  • Footer Cart – Persistent cart summary bar at the bottom with real-time updates and quick checkout access
  • Quick View – Preview products in a modal without leaving the page
  • Floating Add to Cart – Sticky floating add to cart button for easy access
  • Sticky Add to Cart – Keep the add to cart button fixed at top or bottom while scrolling
  • Side Cart Button – Floating side cart button with quick cart access
  • Add to Cart Modify – Customize add to cart button text storewide

🏷️ Marketing & Badges

Product Badge
Display eye-catching labels and badges on products (Sale, New, Hot Deal, etc.). Perfect for highlighting promotions and grabbing attention.

  • Trust Badge – Build credibility with trust badges and payment method logos
  • Free Shipping Badge – Automatically display free shipping badges on qualifying products

📦 Product Management

Pre-Order
Allow customers to preorder out-of-stock products. Features include:

  • Enable preorders for simple and variable products
  • Custom preorder pricing (full, partial, or free)
  • Availability date management with automatic status changes
  • Stock management and order processing workflow
  • Customizable button text and styling

🔍 Search & Navigation

Search from Anywhere
Add a global search bar with real-time product results and autocomplete suggestions from any page.

  • Scroll to Top – Floating back to top button with smooth scrolling
  • Inactive Tab Message – Display custom messages in browser tab to bring users back

⚖️ Legal & Compliance

Cookies Banner
Display GDPR and CCPA compliant cookie consent banners with customizable styling and placement.

  • Allow to Terms – Add customizable terms and conditions checkboxes to checkout and registration

💬 Social Proof

Customer Review
Advanced review system with verified buyer badges, image/video uploads, helpful voting, and automated review requests.

💳 Payment Display

Payment Logo
Display payment method logos to build trust and show accepted payment methods.

Additional Information

For more information and updates, visit the official website https://softtent.com/managex.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPL-2.0-or-later License.
sections.installation:
1. Upload softtent-managex to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Dashboard > ManageX to browse and enable extensions.
  4. Enable desired extensions and customize their settings.
  5. Use rule-based targeting to apply extensions to specific products, categories, or tags.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, ManageX is built specifically for WooCommerce and requires WooCommerce to be installed and activated.

What extensions are included?

ManageX includes 18+ extensions organized into categories:
– Cart & Checkout: Buy Now, Footer Cart, Quick View, Floating/Sticky/Side Add to Cart buttons
– Marketing & Badges: Product Badge, Trust Badge, Free Shipping Badge
– Product Management: Pre-Order
– Search & Navigation: Search from Anywhere, Scroll to Top, Inactive Tab Message
– Legal & Compliance: Cookies Banner, Allow to Terms
– Social Proof: Customer Review
– Payment Display: Payment Logo

How do I enable extensions for my products?

Go to Dashboard > ManageX, enable your desired extensions, and configure their settings. Most extensions support rule-based targeting to apply them to specific products, categories, or tags.

Can I customize the appearance of badges and buttons?

Yes, all extensions come with comprehensive styling options including colors, typography, padding, margins, borders, positioning, and hover states.

Are extensions compatible with page builders?

Yes, most extensions include shortcode support for manual placement with page builders like Elementor, Divi, or Gutenberg.

Do extensions work with variable products?

Yes, core extensions like Pre-Order, Buy Now, Quick View, and Product Badge fully support WooCommerce variable products.

Is this plugin translation ready?

Yes, ManageX follows WordPress internationalization standards and can be translated using .mo/.po files.

Need Any Help?

Please mail us at contact@softtent.com
